verdict.rationale: cubic documents a dedicated cross-repo review feature. Users link related repositories so reviews can check shared APIs, schemas, docs, or release work and catch changes that need a matching update in another repo. Its AI chat also reads the PR alongside the rest of the codebase, which supports coherent multi-repo understanding. Missing for 10: any specific evidence of large-monorepo handling (scale, scoping), detail on how cross-repo findings are presented, and independent or hands-on corroboration that cross-repo reviews work as claimed.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, the reviewer understands changes that span multiple repositories or a large monorepo and reviews them coherently
